mostWorthwhile.text: Microscopy was most worthwhile: turning the stage revealed the jointed body while preserving it in the ice, advancing both the discovery and its careful handling.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: the optical face made a view possible, and the cold microscope resolved it without touching the specimen.

continue.text: I would continue to learn what Earth makes of the preserved body; the careful preparation made the discovery feel consequential.
